timer: std::chrono::steady_clock, nanoseconds; only the planner call is between the two reads
logging: std::cout has no stream buffer for the whole run, so library prints return after a state check; BFS::findPath still executes its per-node print statements
pinning: pinned to logical processor 0 (efficiency class 1 of 2 classes; higher is faster); process priority above normal, thread priority highest
phases: end_to_end = NavigationCore::handleObstacles; copy = Graph copy constructor; remove = Graph::removeNode per blocked node; search_first = AStar constructor + first findPath on the copy; search_cached = second findPath on the same AStar
